name: Notion
description: Productivity/project management: connected workspace for docs, wikis and databases with a REST API over pages, databases, blocks, users and comments.
access_notes: Free plan available; internal connections (static API tokens) and public OAuth connections are both created self-serve in the Notion developer portal / integration settings.
mcp_notes: Official hosted Notion MCP at https://mcp.notion.com/mcp (OAuth; SSE fallback at /sse); the open-source makenotion/notion-mcp-server is soft-deprecated in favor of the remote server. Composio NOTION toolkit exists (56 tools, 8 triggers, OAUTH2/API_KEY, Composio managed auth).
uncertainty_notes: All API tokens are passed as bearer tokens; 'api_key' refers to internal-connection static tokens and 'personal_access_token' to user-scoped PATs. Webhook events are sparse (metadata only) and require follow-up API calls for content.

evidence.note: API accepts bearer tokens from internal connections, personal access tokens, or the OAuth flow for public connections; REST base api.notion.com/v1.
Internal connections use a static API token, PATs are user-scoped static tokens, and public connections use OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow (api.notion.com/v1/oauth/token, HTTP Basic client auth).
Webhooks send HTTP POST events for page/database/comment changes; subscriptions created self-serve in connection settings with HMAC signature verification.
'Notion MCP is a remote MCP server hosted by Notion' with OAuth authorization; endpoints mcp.notion.com/mcp and /sse.
Composio toolkit catalog lists Notion (slug NOTION, 56 tools, 8 triggers, OAUTH2/API_KEY, Composio managed app: Yes).
